questions.question: [The League of Nations] Explain two weaknesses of the League of Nations. (4 marks)
questions.correctAnswer: The League had no army of its own - it could not enforce decisions militarily and had to rely on member states to provide troops, who often refused. The unanimity rule meant that any Council member could veto action, so a single "no" vote could prevent the League from responding to aggression.

questions.question: [The League of Nations] How important was America's absence from the League of Nations? (8 marks)
questions.correctAnswer: America's absence was critically important. Without the USA, the League lacked the world's most powerful economy and military.
